stem: Why did the United States intervene in Korea during the mid-twentieth century?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States wanted to promote trade in Southeast Asia.

options.label: B
options.text: The United States responded to a surprise attack against a U.S. naval base.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States assumed responsibility for defeating international terrorist groups.

options.label: D
options.text: The United States led the international community in response to an act of aggression.
